title: marrubium cuneatum var. spinulosum
intro:
Marrubium cuneatum var. spinulosum, commonly known as the Spiny Horehound, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) known for its unique characteristics and medicinal properties.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Marrubium cuneatum var. spinulosum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
